blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It appears that the long hours of the impeachment trial are finally taking its toll, as both the prosecution panel and the clerk of court secretariat were scolded for some minor inefficiencies during the proceedings on Wednesday. During the latter part of the trial, Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero called out the assisting counsel for the prosecution for failing to be of help to public prosecutor and Cagayan de Oro Rep. Lordan Suan, who was presenting witnesses from insurance companies from which Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband Manases Carpio had purchased policies from. Escudero said […]...
